info.title: monday (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Monday.com API v2. All requests are POST to the same endpoint with a GraphQL query in the body. Authorization: Bearer {api_token}. board_id and item_id are integers (pass as strings). column_id is the column's internal ID (e.g. 'status', 'date4', 'text').

post.summary: Search for an item by name on a Monday.com board. Returns the item ID required for subsequent column update operations.
post.description: Search for an item by name on a Monday.com board. Returns the item ID required for subsequent column update operations.

200.description: {items: [{id, name, board: {id, name}, column_values: [{id, title, text, value}]}]}

requestBody.description: Body: {board_id (required, string â€” board ID), name (required, string â€” item name to search for)}

post.summary: Add a new row (item) to a Monday.com board.
post.description: Add a new row (item) to a Monday.com board.

requestBody.description: Body: {board_id (required, string â€” board ID), item_name (required, string â€” name for the new item), group_id (optional, string â€” group/section ID to place the item in), column_values (optional, JSON string â€” initial column values as a JSON object mapping column IDs to values, e.g. '{"status":"Done","date4":"2024-01-15"}')}

post.description: Set a column value for an item. Use column_type to indicate the kind of column: 'status' for status/dropdown columns, 'date' for date columns (value: YYYY-MM-DD), 'number' for numeric columns, 'text' for text columns.

requestBody.description: Body: {board_id (required, string â€” board ID), column_id (required, string â€” column internal ID), value (required, string â€” new value; for status use the label text, for date use YYYY-MM-DD, for number use a numeric string), column_type (optional, string: 'status'|'date'|'number'|'text' â€” helps route to the correct update function)}

value.description: Underlying raw JSON value for the column.
